chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: Kid Thomas and George Lewis
summary: Kid Thomas was well regarded with a good variety band; George Lewis was a good clarinetist who worked with everybody.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: But never a regular band. Never a regular band. Well how would somebody like Kid Thomas rate then? Well I'll tell you about him, as far as I know about him. I think he had a pretty good rating as far as his playing, but otherwise I wouldn't know. Well he played good. Yeah, but I mean he was known on this side of the river at that time?

Excuse me, people knew him. Yeah. He was well known. I didn't know whether he was well known on this side of the river. Yeah, yeah, he was well known on this side. He had his own band. Yeah. Yeah. He was well known. He was well known.
And he does some good work, you know what I mean, with his band. He's done good work. Variety music?
Good work. What about George Lewis?

George Lewis, yeah, I know him good too. This whole fella died not too long. Yeah, I wasn't sure. Yeah. Yeah, he was good too. Good clarinet. What band did he work with? Well, I believe he worked with everybody. Yeah. Yeah.
